## Installing

| | Download |
| --- | --- |
| macOS 12 or later | `JobPilot_<version>_universal.dmg` |
| Windows 10 or later | `JobPilot_<version>_x64-setup.exe` |
| Debian, Ubuntu | `.deb` for `amd64` or `arm64` |
| Fedora, openSUSE | `.rpm` for `x86_64` or `aarch64` |
| The CLI alone | `jobpilot-cli_<version>_<os>_<arch>` |

Install a new version over the old one.
Your data stays where it is.

## Opening it the first time

This release is not signed yet, so your system asks once whether to trust it.

- **macOS.** Open JobPilot, choose Done when macOS says it cannot check it, then go to System Settings → Privacy & Security and choose Open Anyway.
- **Windows.** When SmartScreen says it protected your PC, choose More info, then Run anyway.

`SHA256SUMS` lists every file's checksum.
